figs.name: hazardous-area-classification-zone-0-1-2-tank-diagram
figs.alt: hazardous area classification diagram of zone 0, zone 1 and zone 2 around a tank
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing Zone 0 inside a flammable liquid tank, Zone 1 around the vent and Zone 2 outside, with hours per year and equipment category.
figs.after_h2: Zone 0, Zone 1 and Zone 2: IEC 60079-10-1 Definitions
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Hazardous area zones around a flammable liquid storage tank: Zone 0, Zone 1 and Zone 2</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hazardous Area Zones Around a Tank</text>
<ellipse cx="270" cy="330" rx="240" ry="200" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/>
<ellipse cx="270" cy="330" rx="165" ry="140" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/>
<rect x="185" y="260" width="170" height="200" rx="8" fill="#fecaca" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="262" y="236" width="16" height="24" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="270" y="345" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 0</text>
<text x="270" y="372" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inside tank</text>
<text x="270" y="228" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vent</text>
<text x="147" y="336" font-size="18" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 1</text>
<text x="270" y="168" font-size="19" fill="#854d0e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 2</text>
<rect x="540" y="80" width="240" height="120" rx="12" fill="#fecaca" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660" y="112" font-size="20" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 0</text>
<text x="660" y="144" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">more than 1,000 h per year</text>
<text x="660" y="174" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Category 1G, Ex ia</text>
<rect x="540" y="220" width="240" height="120" rx="12" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660" y="252" font-size="20" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 1</text>
<text x="660" y="284" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 to 1,000 h per year</text>
<text x="660" y="314" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Category 2G, Ex d, e, ib</text>
<rect x="540" y="360" width="240" height="120" rx="12" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="660" y="392" font-size="20" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zone 2</text>
<text x="660" y="424" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">less than 10 h per year</text>
<text x="660" y="454" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Category 3G, Ex n, e, p</text>
<text x="400" y="548" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Real zone boundaries come from gas dispersion study, not fixed radii</text>
</svg>

figs.name: hazardous-area-classification-ex-equipment-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to select Ex equipment by zone, gas group, temperature class and protection
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to select Ex equipment: find the zone, category, gas group, temperature class below the gas auto ignition temperature, protection method and marking.
figs.after_h2: Temperature Classes (T-Classes): Preventing Ignition by Hot Surfaces
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for selecting Ex equipment: zone, gas group, temperature class and protection method</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Selecting Ex Equipment for a Hazardous Area</text>
<rect x="40" y="62" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="92" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">1. Find the zone</text>
<text x="60" y="120" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">how long the explosive atmosphere is present</text>
<line x1="300" y1="135" x2="300" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="151" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="181" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">2. Pick the category</text>
<text x="60" y="209" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">1G for Zone 0, 2G for Zone 1, 3G for Zone 2</text>
<line x1="300" y1="224" x2="300" y2="239" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="240" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="270" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">3. Pick the gas group</text>
<text x="60" y="298" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">IIC covers IIB and IIA; IIA only for IIA gases</text>
<line x1="300" y1="313" x2="300" y2="328" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="329" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="359" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">4. Pick the T class</text>
<text x="60" y="387" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">max surface temperature below the gas AIT</text>
<line x1="300" y1="402" x2="300" y2="417" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="418" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="448" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">5. Pick the protection</text>
<text x="60" y="476" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Ex ia, d, e, n, p by zone and device type</text>
<line x1="300" y1="491" x2="300" y2="506" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="507" width="520" height="72" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="537" font-size="19" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">6. Check the marking</text>
<text x="60" y="565" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">nameplate code matches all of the above</text>
<rect x="585" y="290" width="190" height="230" rx="12" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#831843" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="680" y="322" font-size="18" fill="#831843" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T class example</text>
<text x="680" y="356" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">H2S AIT is</text>
<text x="680" y="386" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">about 260°C</text>
<text x="680" y="416" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T3 (200°C): safe</text>
<text x="680" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T2 (300°C): not</text>
<text x="680" y="476" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">acceptable</text>
<polyline points="562,383 583,383" fill="none" stroke="#831843" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>

figs.name: hazardous-area-classification-ex-marking-code-infographic
figs.alt: how to read Ex equipment marking code II 2G Ex d IIB T4 Gb
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog decoding the Ex marking II 2G Ex d IIB T4 Gb part by part, with a second example of an intrinsically safe Zone 0 marking.
figs.after_h2: How to Read Ex Equipment Marking Codes

<rect x="278" y="180" width="118" height="150" rx="10" fill="#fdf2f8" stroke="#be185d" stroke-width="2"/>
